cr_steward.text: Welcome to Bunratty. Sit anywhere. Tonight's menu is mead and meat. Sláinte!
The castle was falling down in the 1950s, and Lord Gort bought it and put the walls back on. He'd the money, he'd the notion, and he'd the taste, which is rare in all three.

cr_ennis_local.text: O'Connell's statue is up on the column. Fair play to him. A Catholic, a Kerryman, and a lawyer, and it was Clare that sent him to Westminster. They never saw it coming.
Ennis is the music town. Every second pub has a session going, and the third has a better one.

cr_fiddler.text: Kilfenora has a céilí band that's been going since 1909. A dozen or so of them, and you could hear them in the next parish.
A reel is a reel and a jig is a jig. But a Clare reel has a lift in it you won't get elsewhere. I'm not biased. I'm from Clare.

champ_cr_musician.text: Ah, hello. I'm only out for the air. The fiddle just came along. She's very clingy.

intro: A tune and a battle. Which first? Ah, never mind, the battle.
I've the team for the day, and the mood to go with it.
champ_cr_musician.win: That was a good bit of playing. Not a note wasted, and I'm including mine.
champ_cr_musician.tired: A week between tunes, no more. Monday, and I'll have a set ready.
